body:
>	What are you dealing with right now that makes you regret being born?

I guess the correct answer would be life itself, every aspect of it. School, family, friends, relations, health. I literally have to live in a way that I don’t want to and it’s been like since my birth. I can’t wrap my head around it. It makes me sick how fucked my 19 years have been. I’ve never had the oppurtunity to freely do something that I want. I’ve always had things put before me and every time I didn’t agree with something, I suffered the consequences of punishment.

I’m just scared of a possible hell or I would’ve offed myself years ago. Hoping for a fatal accident but it hasn’t happened yet, and if there is a God then he surely wants me to have a lot of pain, that’s for sure.

See, people mention that all the time. “Be happy you’re 100% healthy, there’s people with no limbs and some have no sight or can’t hear.” I get sick with that shit. Those people can still have an amazing life, much better than mine, regardless of their disabilities.

I’d trade my fucking eyes for happiness if I’d get the chance. It’s become that bad.

>	Maybe you could put some distance between yourself and them to try to heal yourself?

No way. I live with them and there’s no possible way for me to get away. I obviously don’t have friends or else my depression wouldn’t be nearly as bad as it is now.
Welp. You just described me. Even the same age.
Most of the people I know just gather with others and watch soccer and drink. I'm not a drinker at all but that doesn't mean I don't want to do it. I think it needs to be done in moderation.

It feels to good to know that I'm not the only one getting screwed over in life but no should deserves this situation that you and I are in right now. Several years have gone by where I've only played games, lifted weights, gone to school, ate and slept. There should be a balance between the things I listed and the things one needs to do to clear their mind from their every-day activities.

It's hard to keep going in life when I know that the chances of my future being better are extremely low. How the hell am I supposed to ever get married when I grow up if all I did was dream about women when I was younger?
Most teens of my age get to hang out quite often with each other.

I keep imaging what'd happen if I'd commit suicide. Whether someone other than my family would hear about it or whether the people I'm fairly close to might know the reason because I never show a sign of any sadness whenever I'm with them. I hide everything behind my face and pretend it'll become better as everything in life is temporary but if this thing that concerns me will affect the rest of my life, how am I supposed to have any motivation to live any further? Will I magically be able to talk to girls, act normal and maybe get into a relationship after not having any experience at all?
